blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) reported a 32% decline in focus crimes nationwide from July to October 2026. “Our latest figures show a downward trend in focus crimes over the past four months,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a press briefing on Monday. “From July to October 2026, the PNP recorded over 9,000 focus crimes incidents nationwide, down by 4,354 cases or 32% from the 30,401 cases recorded in the same period last year,” he added.
